heading "General proposal"
paragraph "protected modifier acts the same as private in terms of code generation and assignability, except that it is possible to access a protected member in any subclass of a class which declared the member."

code "class Base { protected x: string; } class Derived extends Base { foo(n: Base) { // Not allowed: cannot reference protected member through base class reference console.log(n.x); } }"

[ax-51000035] button "Copy code to clipboard"

paragraph "However, if we do not use the \"same declaration\" rule, then a SquareWidget would be assignable to a CirceWidget even if they both removed their extends clauses. This is not surprising if you're used t"
